legacy_row: **The control arm, made real (`B55`).** The adherence harness deleted the measured instruction from **one** command file while four others still ordered the same call — so the arm labelled *"instruction deleted"* contained it four more times, and no run could distinguish *"the instruction works"* from *"the agent found it elsewhere."* The canary now declares all five directive sites and the control arm deletes every one; an **independent leak walk** verifies the tree **without consulting `canary.deletions`**, because a check that reads the deletion list can only find sites the list already knows. `B41-phase-entry` re-ran **`OBEYED`** — treatment 3/3, control 0/3, seam PASS — **the first verdict this harness has produced that means what it says**, and the one that re-earns the provenance `E8`'s row withdrew. Six criteria were verified by **mutation** rather than RED-first and are recorded as a *declared deviation*, never counted as strict-Nyquist compliance. Closed `B55`, `B80`, `B83`. Retro: [`M5.E15-RETROSPECTIVE.md`](M5.E15-RETROSPECTIVE.md).
